sloka: न ब्राह्मण धनम् किम्चिद्द् हृतम् रामेण कस्यचित् ।कश्चिन् न आढ्यो दरिद्रः वा तेन अपापो विहिम्सितः ॥२-७२-४८॥
transliteration: na brāhmaṇa dhanam kimcidd hṛtam rāmeṇa kasyacit ।kaścin na āḍhyo daridraḥ vā tena apāpo vihimsitaḥ ॥2-72-48॥

translations.english: Rama did not rob any brahmin of even a little wealth nor did he harm any innocent man, whether rich or poor. He never casts his eyes on another's wife.
